description: How the customer roles of a real estate organisation on the platform relate to each other: who mandates whom to manage property, who lets to and collects from whom, how work flows from fault report to supplier and back as an invoice, how money settles between tenants, owners, associations and suppliers, and which information loops steer the business and keep clients.

relationTypes.name: Commercial
relationTypes.description: Mandates, leases, letting and quotes between the parties

relationTypes.name: Operational
relationTypes.description: Day-to-day tickets, work orders, onboarding and administration hand-offs

relationTypes.name: Financial
relationTypes.description: Rent, contributions, statements, payouts and supplier settlement

relationTypes.name: Information
relationTypes.description: Reports, documents, approvals, ratings and management steering

relations.name: Grants a management mandate
relations.description: Hands the property to the manager under a management agreement with fee, mandate threshold for repairs and statement frequency; the portfolio is onboarded as the owner's entity and objects.

relations.name: Lets the unit and signs the lease
relations.description: Screens the candidate, runs the rent-price check, generates the contract, e-signs it and hands over the keys after the move-in inspection; later processes indexation, changes and termination.

relations.name: Invoices and collects rent
relations.description: Runs the periodic rent invoice and direct debit, reconciles the bank, follows up arrears and settles service charges and the deposit at the end of the lease.

relations.name: Reports faults
relations.description: Reports defects with photos and availability through the tenant app; the ticket lands with the technical manager for triage and dispatch.

relations.name: Dispatches work orders
relations.description: Turns tickets and the periodic maintenance schedule into work orders with photos, access details, installation record and mandate amount, sent to the supplier portal or a connected partner system.

relations.name: Quotes, accepts and reports completion
relations.description: Answers each work order with a quote, acceptance or decline, plans the visit with the tenant, and files the completion report with photos and installation updates.

relations.name: Invoices completed work
relations.description: Submits the invoice against the work order; it is matched to the approved amount, booked to the right entity and object and paid in the payment batch.

relations.name: Requests approval for repairs above mandate
relations.description: Sends quotes above the mandate threshold with ticket, photos, history and budget context to the owner portal and receives the decision back into the work order.

relations.name: Publishes statements and pays out
relations.description: Closes the owner's entity for the period, publishes the owner statement with rent received, costs and fees to the owner portal and pays out the net amount.

relations.name: Invoices contributions and manages the reserve fund
relations.description: Sets the association budget, invoices periodic owner contributions and extra levies, collects them and reports the reserve fund position.

relations.name: Convenes meetings and records decisions
relations.description: Publishes agendas, budgets and documents, runs the meeting with proxy and voting, and records the decisions the owner sees in the portal.

relations.name: Sets letting and asset targets
relations.description: Gives the property manager occupancy, rent level, indexation and turnover targets per complex and follows vacancy and arrears against them.

relations.name: Requests investor and lender reporting
relations.description: Defines the investor report, covenant tests and valuation inputs the controller produces from the closed multi-entity ledger every period.

relations.name: Approves maintenance and capex budgets
relations.description: Sets the multi-year maintenance and transformation budgets the technical manager plans and executes against.

relations.name: Steers on margin, arrears and close
relations.description: Sets margin, arrears and days-to-close targets and reviews the finance dashboards that report against them.

relations.name: Sets service promise and units-per-FTE targets
relations.description: Defines the service levels per client type, the portals to switch on and the units-per-FTE targets the property manager works within.

relations.name: Renews mandates and refers new clients
relations.description: Renewal of management and administration mandates and referrals to other owners signal service quality and feed the director's growth.

relations.name: Requests tenancy changes and gives notice
relations.description: Submits change requests, notice and questions through the tenant portal; the property manager processes them on the contract.
